entries.name: Weatherwise
entries.description: Reads the sky like a book. +5 accuracy and +3 crit chance whenever any weather is active. (The bonuses are folded in at compile time; the WeatherManager re-stamps stat mods on weather change.)

entries.name: Stormborn
entries.description: Born under a storm. +15% Lightning damage and +2 to all damage resistance. Synergizes with Storm Surge and Blizzard weather.
